title: W.M. Keck Foundation awards $1.2 million to KU team pursuing new theory of Alzheimer’s disease
summary_en: Michael Wolfe, interim department chair and Mathias P. Mertes Professor of Medicinal Chemistry, will lead a project exploring stalled enzymes in Alzheimer's disease.
title_cn: W.M. Keck Foundation awards $1.2 million to KU team pursuing new theory of Alzheimer’s disease

title: New 50 percent tariff on Canadian goods ‘unprecedented, erratic, even desperate,’ international trade law scholar says
summary_en: Raj Bhala, University Distinguished Professor of Law at the University of Kansas, is available to media to discuss the newly announced 50% tariffs on a range of Canadian goods. The international trade law expert said the unprecedented move is neither wise nor likely to be effective.
title_cn: New 50 percent tariff on Canadian goods ‘unprecedented, erratic, even desperate,’ international trade law scholar says

title: Researchers develop velocity-based training guidelines for football, tailored for specific positions
summary_en: Researchers at KU’s Jayhawk Athletic Performance Lab have published guidelines for using velocity-based training in college football. The approach measures the speed of a barbell during weight lifting and can be used to develop different types of strength and power. The guidelines help develop training regiments for specific athletes and by position group, based on the unique needs of each.
title_cn: Researchers develop velocity-based training guidelines for football, tailored for specific positions
